spec.situation_desc: had a mortgage payment taken on the wrong date

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Sam speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, it’s Rohan Carmichael. My mortgage payment’s been taken on the wrong date, and I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry that’s happened, Rohan. I can look into it for you. Before we discuss your account, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s verified. I can see why you’re frustrated. We’ll get that payment returned to you, don’t worry.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It was due on the 28th, but you took it on the 19th. That’s a big difference.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand, and I’m sorry for the upset. I’m logging this as a complaint about the payment being taken on the wrong date.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay. I want to know what’s going to happen now.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll take ownership of it. I’ll send the complaint to our mortgage payments team today, and I’ll make sure they contact you by Friday.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Will they explain why it happened?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Yes, they’ll look into what happened and explain the next steps. Someone will be in touch about it.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. I’d appreciate a proper explanation.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course. I’m sorry again, Rohan. I’ll get that over to the team today and make sure they follow up by Friday.
